title: A goal is ready to close only when every approved criterion is verified: closure precondition and the goal.close offer gate
description:
SPIDR child 2 of task-d1c815ebc33346dfb0e837692e2166b5. dependsOn child 1 (task-ae6fd9aca46c42d8af940ff6f336afbb: the live node-evidence leg) because closing a ready goal must succeed once it is offered. Filed by architect-16a01670 2026-09-04, measured at main 68eb1c5d.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: goal-level readiness. (a) A closure PRECONDITION: `goal.close` refuses when any approved criterion of the goal's approved Product Contract is not VERIFIED on the coverage read. (b) The OFFER GATE: `/affordances/read` offers `goal.close` for a contract-bearing goal only when every approved node is accepted AND coverage totals.verified == totals.criteria. Child 3 owns the UI assertions, docs and the live drive.

MEASURED (re-measure before planning):
- The offer today: apps/daemon/src/http/affordance-planning-offers.ts:143-147 returns `[offer(goal.close), publish]` for EVERY goal whose lifecycle is EXECUTION_ENABLED or CLOSING; `offersForGoal(input, goal)` (:55) works from `PlanningOfferInput` facts (`input.compilerLane.factsFor(goalId)` etc.) and has no store; the store lives in affordance-read.ts (:112 `config.store`, :263 readDurableLedger, :364 readReviewLedger per node spec) which composes the input. Add a readiness FACT to the input (e.g. `closeReadiness: (goalId) => \"READY\" | \"NOT_READY\" | \"NO_CONTRACT\"`) computed in affordance-read.ts from `readReviewLedgers(store, projectId, nodeRefs).ledgers[*].accepted` and the coverage totals.
- Coverage totals: `createDocumentCoverageReadPort({ projectId, store, readActive?, readReviews? })` (apps/daemon/src/http/document-coverage-read.ts:57-70, :148) answers `{goalRef}` reads with `totals: { criteria, verified, ... }` (document-coverage-contract.ts:74-81); the same port can serve the precondition from goal-services.ts (`closeGoal` :141-175 calls `qualifyGoalClosure` at :149 - put the criteria check right after it, before `reduceGoal`) or inside `qualify` (goal-qualification.ts:199-233) - architect decides and states why (goal-qualification.ts must stay under 250 lines; goal-services.ts is the cheaper site).
- Contract-less goals (the seed/Foundation journey, tests/e2e/control-room/board-chain.spec.ts:462-472 asserts exactly one goal.close card right after activation; affordance-planning-offers.test.ts:101-104; affordance-read-planning.test.ts:290,:514-545; affordance-read.test.ts:454,:498 pin `[\"approval.decide\", \"goal.close\", \"plan.propose\"]`) keep TODAY's offer: the gate applies only when the goal has an approved Product Contract (criteria > 0); with no contract the readiness is NO_CONTRACT and the offer is unchanged - so the pinned fixtures stay green unless they bind a contract (re-measure each of the six files above and name every one touched in the plan; if that roster exceeds the file budget, split again).
- The ONE new refusal code of the parent row: GOAL_CLOSE_CRITERIA_UNVERIFIED added to GOAL_PREREQUISITE_REFUSAL_CODES (apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-close-prerequisite.ts:34-44) - its consumers are foundation-surface.ts, index.ts (re-export), index-surface.test.ts, runtime-entrypoint.test.ts and goal-services.test.ts: name every pin the plan bumps. Layer stays GOAL_PREREQUISITE_LAYER ("DAEMON_PREREQUISITE").
- Needs-you already derives READY_TO_CLOSE from coverage totals + the presence of the goal.close offer (apps/control-room/src/v2/approvals/needs-you-model.ts:110-135: \"The daemon is not offering to close it yet; open the goal to see why\" when the offer is absent) - no control-room production change is expected; child 3 asserts it.

FEATURE: (a) `goal.close` on a contract-bearing goal with any criterion not VERIFIED refuses GOAL_CLOSE_CRITERIA_UNVERIFIED (message names the count, e.g. \"3 of 10 criteria unverified\"); with all verified it proceeds to the node legs (child 1). (b) `/affordances/read` withholds the goal.close offer for a contract-bearing goal until every approved node is accepted (review ledger `accepted` present, no delta) and totals.verified == totals.criteria; the moment both hold, the offer appears; contract-less goals are offered exactly as today.
definitionOfDone: `goal.close` on a goal with an approved contract and an unverified criterion refuses GOAL_CLOSE_CRITERIA_UNVERIFIED with layer DAEMON_PREREQUISITE and a message naming `<unverified> of <criteria>`; with every criterion VERIFIED (all nodes accepted via seedReviewAcceptance + coverage read totals equal) the same goal closes (child 1's leg) - both over a REAL store; the arm is verified red by mutation.

GOAL_PREREQUISITE_REFUSAL_CODES gains exactly one member and every pinned consumer is updated and named in the completion summary (index-surface.test.ts, runtime-entrypoint.test.ts, goal-services.test.ts, foundation-surface.ts if it enumerates); a bidirectional roster arm asserts the codes the closure surface can emit equal the roster.

`/affordances/read` (affordance-read test over a real store): for a contract-bearing goal the goal.close offer is ABSENT one acceptance before readiness and PRESENT after the last acceptance when totals.verified == totals.criteria; a goal with an unverified criterion but all nodes accepted stays unoffered; a contract-less goal is offered exactly as before (the existing pins at affordance-planning-offers.test.ts:101-104, affordance-read.test.ts:454/:498 and affordance-read-planning.test.ts:514-545 stay green or are updated only where they bind a contract, each named).

tests/e2e/control-room/board-chain.spec.ts (contract-less chain) stays green unchanged - `pnpm test:e2e:browser` count line quoted; the MCP-excluded / HUMAN_ONLY_STEPS rosters for goal.close are unchanged (mcp-tool-allowlist.test.ts count line quoted).
Gates quoted with count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test:e2e:browser`; every production file touched stays under 250 lines (`wc -l` quoted), hard stop 400.
taskRails: CONTRACT-LESS GOALS KEEP TODAY'S OFFER: the gate applies only when an approved Product Contract with criteria > 0 exists; the seed/Foundation journey and its pinned fixtures are not re-shaped.
READINESS IS READ, NEVER STORED: both the precondition and the offer derive from the coverage read and the review ledgers at request time (re-measured, never cached at plan time).

ONE new code, every consumer named (global rail: grep the SHAPE - roster pins, count pins, fixture goldens); if the consumer roster exceeds the file budget, split before submitting. Refusals assert code AND layer AND message; mutate to prove red (global rail 1). <=250 lines per production source, hard stop 400.
